NA_L2NAMEMISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
NA_L1NAME
properties.Common Soi: Schriever, Barbary, Fausse, Cancienne, Grammercy, Galvez, Thibaut
properties.Land Cover: Forested wetlands, wildlife habitat, recreation, aquaculture, fishing and hunting; oil and gas production.
properties.NA_L2NAME: MISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
properties.Natural Ve: Tupelo-cypress swamp forest with sedges, grasses, and rushes in frequently flooded areas. Overcup oak-water hickory forest and oak-sweetgum forest in areas flooded less frequently. Live oak and Spanish moss are also common. Other wetland vegetation inclu
properties.Physiograp: Flat alluvial plain with a transition to a deltaic plain. Backswamps, bayous, distributary ridges, and natural levees. Wetlands, low-gradient streams and channelized streams.
properties.Soils Orde: Vertisols (Epiaquerts), Entisols (Hydraquents), Inceptisols (Endoaquepts), Alfisols (Endoaqualfs)
properties.Surfical a: Quaternary (Holocene) alluvial deposits. Lacustrine deposits, alluvium with organic deposits.

properties.name: 65f  Southern Pine Plains and Hills
properties.descriptio:
US_L3NAMESoutheastern Plains
NA_L2NAMESOUTHEASTERN USA PLAINS
NA_L1NAMEEASTERN TEMPERATE FORESTS
properties.Common Soi: Savannah, Ruston, Smithdale, Tangi, Toula, Prentiss, Latonia, Bassfield, Cahaba; on floodplains Guyton, Ouachita, Ochlockonee.
properties.Land Cover: Forestland, pine plantations, pasture and hayland, cattle and dairy production, some minor cropland.
properties.Natural Ve: Pine and pine-oak forest. Mostly longleaf pine, some slash pine in wet areas, southern red oak, post oak, mockernut hickory, flowering dogwood, and loblolly pine; some southern floodplain forest with cypress-gum swamp and bottomland hardwoods.
properties.Physiograp: Coastal plains moderately to deeply dissected by streams into low rolling hills and broad gently sloping ridges. Low- to moderate-gradient streams with sand to clay bottoms.
properties.Soils Orde: Ultisols (Paleudults, Hapludults, Fragiudults), Alfisols (Glossaqualfs), Entisols (Udifluvents), Inceptisols (Dystrudepts)
properties.Surfical a: Quaternary alluvial pebble gravel and sand; Tertiary (Pliocene) gravel, sand, and clay.

properties.name: 73k  Southern Holocene Meander Belts
properties.descriptio:
US_L3NAMEMississippi Alluvial Plain
NA_L2NAMEMISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
NA_L1NAME
properties.Common Soi: Commerce, Convent, Crevasse, Robinsonville, Dundee, Sharkey, Tunica, Newellton, Schriever, Gramercy, Baldwin, Thibaut, Cancienne, Galvez
properties.Land Cover: Forested wetlands, deciduous forest, cropland with sugarcane, cotton, soybeans, and corn; pasture; crawfish aquaculture; some urban and industrial.
properties.NA_L2NAME: MISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
properties.Natural Ve: In wettest areas, cypress-gum swamps (bald cypress, water tupelo); on less flooded zones, overcup oak, Nuttall oak, willow oak, water hickory, elm, green ash, sweetgum; on point bars and natural levees, sweetgum, ash, cottonwood, some areas of live oak.
properties.Physiograp: Flat plains and river meander belts with levees, point bars, oxbows, and abandoned channels. Large rivers and some smaller low-gradient streams, channelized in many places.
properties.Soils Orde: Inceptisols (Endoaquepts, Epiaquepts), Entisols (Udifluvents, Udipsamments), Alfisols (Epiaqualfs, Endoaqualfs), Vertisols (Epiaquerts)
properties.Surfical a: Quaternary (Holocene) alluvial sand, silt, clay, and gravel.

properties.name: 73l  Southern Pleistocene Valley Trains
properties.descriptio:
US_L3NAMEMississippi Alluvial Plain
NA_L2NAMEMISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
NA_L1NAME
properties.Common Soi: Bursley, Forestdale, Foley, Calhoun, Necessity, Deerford, Dowling, Sharkey
properties.Land Cover: Deciduous forest, forested wetlands, cropland with cotton, soybeans, and corn.
properties.NA_L2NAME: MISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
properties.Natural Ve: Bottomland forest with overcup oak, Nuttall oak, honey locust, elm, water oak, sweetgum, blackgum, hickory, and Spanish moss.
properties.Physiograp: Flat to irregular alluvial plain with relict patterns of branching channels, terraces, irregular braid bars, and interfluve areas. Low-gradient streams with silty substrates, channelized in many places.
properties.Soils Orde: Alfisols (Glossaqualfs, Natraqualfs, Fraglossudalfs, Endoaqualfs, Natraqualfs), Inceptisols (Endoaquepts), Vertisols (Epiaquerts)
properties.Surfical a: Quaternary (Pleistocene) unconsolidated silty alluvium and alluvial sand, generally 5 to 15 feet in depth. Older alluvial deposits greater than 100 feet deep. Alluvium covers Pleistocene sand and gravel, glacial outwash (early to late Wisconsin deposits)

properties.Common Soi: Scatlake, Timbalier, Bellpass, Clovelly, Lafitte, Bancker, Allemands, Kenner, Larose
properties.L4_KEY: 73o  Deltaic Coastal Marshes and Barrier Islands
properties.Land Cover: Marshland, wildlife habitat, oil and gas production; hunting, trapping, and fishing. Levees of the Mississippi River support citrus orchards and pasture.
properties.NA_L2NAME: MISSISSIPPI ALLUVIAL AND SOUTHEAST USA COASTAL PLAINS
properties.Natural Ve: Freshwater to saltwater marsh vegetation of grasses, sedges, and rushes. Few to no trees. Alligator weed, spike rush, maidencane, cutgrass, and bulltongue in freshwater marshes. Marshhay cordgrass, Olney bulrush, and saltgrass in brackish areas, with smo
properties.Physiograp: Flat deltaic and coastal plain with fresh-water and saline marshes. Rivers, lakes, bayous, tidal channels, canals, and barrier islands.
properties.Soils Orde: Histosols (Haplosaprists), Entisols (Hydraquents)
properties.Surfical a: Quaternary (Holocene) alluvial, deltaic, interdeltaic coastal, and shallow marine sediments of sand, silt, and clay of comparatively high organic content, including peat deposits in places.
